title: Trace Bit
body:
The T bit in the [[Motorola 68000]]'s [[Status Register]]. When it is set, the processor
takes a trace exception after *every* instruction, handing control to a handler that can
inspect the machine state before letting the next one run.

That is single-stepping, and it is how a hardware-level debugger is built: set the trace
bit, and the debugger's handler gets called between each instruction of the program under
test.
